assertions: The response routes the genome-location task to the sequence-tools sub-skill.
The response sets BLAT seqtype="protein" and assembly="mouse" (mapped to mm39) because the DNA-only peptide would otherwise be auto-detected as nucleotide.
The response lists the normalized BLAT result columns including genome, %_matched, chromosome, strand, start, and end from api-reference.md.
The response tells the user to inspect the returned genome column because an unrecognized assembly can fall back to UCSC's default genome.
The response does not direct the user to the original gget source repository checkout.
